meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Relay FM membership and sponsor blurbs, blurs or hides artwork, and trims subscribe links, show notes and footer.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out. Home: headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) plus the HTML served to an iPhone UA. Show (/connected) and episode (/connected/628) pages: the server-rendered HTML (the site is not script-rendered, so phone and desktop markup are the same; only one UA was fetched). Fixtures real*.html are sanitised excerpts (text, images and scripts removed, repeated cards trimmed).

LIVE counts (querySelectorAll on the live DOM): membership-promo both home 2, show 0, episode 0; support-buttons both home 0, show 4, episode 4; sponsor-lists both home 5, show 0, episode 1; artwork-blur both home 9, show 1, episode 1; artwork-hide both home 9, show 1, episode 1; subscribe-links both home 0, show 39, episode 39; show-notes both home 0, show 0, episode 1; footer both home 1, show 1, episode 1.

Site has no cookie banner, ad slots or app banner; the three generic 1.0.0 rules are kept and match nothing live (synthetic fixtures only). Selectors use readable Bootstrap-era class names (promo, home__sp, sp-area, support-link, subscribe-link, episode__show-notes); no hashed classes.

Choices: artwork is Show/Blur/Hide (blur 12px).

NOT verified: logged-in Relay Member pages, the membership page, live-show page, other locales.
